topology.description: Four opposed channels share sensory recruitment of a reduced forward wave. Rectified left/right and dorsal/ventral differences add axis-specific anterior activity; continuous motor activation drives one body with simultaneous yaw and local-binormal pitch.
limitations: This combines two reduced circuit priors; it is not a complete identified L1 spatial steering connectome.
The four motor pools are aggregate research populations and do not add unobserved individual thoracic motor identities.
Roll control, individual attachment coordinates, CSA, force gains, and measured 3D joint moments are absent.

parameter_provenance.objective: Preserve zero-input rest and yaw rotational equivariance while simultaneous horizontal and dorsoventral receptor differences create nonzero 3D curvature in one body.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: All currents, delays, thoracic overrides, equal pool recruitment, curvature gains, virtual rails, and contact values are research parameters. Yaw 0.10 and pitch 0.20 retain the separately audited stable fixtures; they are not measured L1 constants. The terrain Coulomb coefficient 0.35 is a MODEL_FITTED contact value, not an L1 substrate measurement.
